VERIFY_EMAIL.SUBJECT: Confirm your email address
VERIFY_EMAIL.INTRO: Thanks for signing up. Please confirm your email address to activate your account.

RESET_PASSWORD.SUBJECT: Reset your password
RESET_PASSWORD.INTRO: We received a request to reset the password of your account.
RESET_PASSWORD.EXPIRY: This link expires in {duration} and can be used once.

ORDER_CREATED.SUBJECT: Order {code} has been placed
ORDER_CREATED.INTRO: Thank you for your order. We have received order {code} and will confirm it shortly.

CONFIRMED.SUBJECT: Order {code} has been confirmed
CONFIRMED.INTRO: Good news: order {code} has been confirmed and is being prepared for shipping.

REJECTED.SUBJECT: Order {code} has been rejected
REJECTED.INTRO: We are sorry, order {code} has been rejected and will not be shipped.

ORDER_AUTO_CANCELLED.SUBJECT: Order {code} has been cancelled
ORDER_AUTO_CANCELLED.INTRO: Order {code} was cancelled automatically because it was not confirmed within {days} days. Its items are back on sale, so you are welcome to order again.

MONTHLY_REVENUE_REPORT.INTRO: Here is the summary of {period}. Only delivered orders count, by the day they were delivered.

MONTHLY_REVENUE_REPORT.NO_COMPARISON: No revenue the month before to compare with
